g.text: Schematic Stribeck-style curve with an arbitrary scaled lubrication parameter and assigned friction trend. Boundaries are illustrative, not numerical
selection criteria. At full film, viscous shear can increase friction as speed or viscosity rises; film thickness and roughness determine actual surface
